intro: Sifting through loose dirt in Dustwallow Marsh, you come upon an orc's severed hand clutching a tube carved from bone. Inside lies a dirt-stained parchment in Orcish script, which looks important. It is meant for a Theramore Lieutenant.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found. And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube. And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.
The parchment is written in orcish... And it looks important.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have a report to make?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm... I can't read orcish very well, but this looks like a report... Written by an orc spy!
